task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Catch the black base with tilted gray panel, pick it up, and rotate to view the qrcode.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架抓住带有倾斜灰色面板的黑色底座，将其拿起，旋转以查看二维码。
